(237)༄༅/ /mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rjes gnang bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (237)༄༅// mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rjes gnang bzhugs so//

(238)༄༅// gang gi blo gros mkha' ltar rab yangs pa// sgrib tshogs 'khrul pa'i sprin tshogs kun dag nas// ye shes snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas nas// mi shes mun sel 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud// 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rjes su gnang ba byed pa la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum mo// dang po sngon 'gro la gnyis te/ bkod pa bshams pa dang*/ mngon rtogs bsgoms nas bdag 'jug len pa'o// dang po ni maṇ+ḍal spos kyis chag chag gdab la/ re khās pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte ba ser/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ mtshams bzhi mdzes tshon bkye zhing*/ dbus su lha tshom gur gum gyi mdog ltar dgod/ de'i mthar mar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ de'i zur du las bum zhig bshams/ de dag ni bkod pa bshams pa'o// bdag 'jug len pa la don bzhi ste/ dang po bde ba'i gdan la gnas pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ yan lag bdun pa bya ba dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs so// gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs ni// swa bhā wa sa stong par bsgom pa'o// gsum pa bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ mngon byang lngas 'jam dbyangs gur gum gyi mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khrid yig ltar bskyed la/ de la ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ bsnyen pa bskyal lo// mdun bskyed kyang tshul 'di nyid kyis bsgrub bo// las bum gyi nang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gzhung bzhin bskyed la/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab gzhung bzhin bya'o// de nas rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed gnyis kyi lha'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'khor zhing thugs brgyud bskul nas/ sngags gsungs shing sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa (239)gang bar

bsams la bsnyen pa bskyal lo// slar de dag la mchod cing gtor ma phul/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas skabs 'dir yang 'og nas byung ba'i rim pas/ bar ting nge 'dzin gyis bdag 'jug blangs par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'i rjes su gnang ba'o// dang po ni/ slob ma rnams las bum gyi chus khrus byas nas gral la 'khod de/ bgegs gtor btang zhing*/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas bla ma rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bla mas skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ thal mo sbyar la nga'i rjes zlos mdzod cig ces brjod la/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum gyis sdom pa byin/ de nas sems bskyed kyi sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim bzhin du bslab par bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum bya/ de nas yan lag bdun pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid// bla ma 'jam dbyangs la phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sdig pa thams cad (240)cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes lan gsum byed do//

de dag gis sngon 'gro rnams song nas// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rjes su gnang ba'o// dang po bla ma la sku'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai/ ston pa thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'jam dpal dbyangs// bdag cag 'khor bas 'jigs shing thugs rjes bzung du gsol// mun par gyur pa'i 'gro ba'i grong khyer na// 'jigs shing ya nga khyod la gsol ba 'debs// bde ba chen po mya ngan 'das pa'i grong*// zhabs kyi rdul la reg cing rjes gnang stsal du gsol// ces lan gsum mo// de nas slob dpon gyis gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ bdag gi thugs rje'i nyi ma yi// 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel// khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum la// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab// ces brjod do// de nas slob ma rnams a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ skad cig gis 'jam dbyangs mngon rtogs ltar bskyed la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tha mi dad par gyur pa'i thugs ka'i dhīḥyig las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams thams cad 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam pa/ sku chung la yan lag dang phyag mtshan gsal ba dpag tu med pa byung bas slob ma'i lus la thim/ bla ma'i sku las kyang 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku dpag tu med pa (241)chad nas/ slob ma'i lus la mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar sib sib thim par bsgom la/ me tog gtor ba'am/ yang na 'jam dbyangs kyi sku spyi bor bzhag cing*/ spos dud rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ slob dpon gyi ngag tu/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// ār+ya mañdzu shrī ཿdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod do// de ltar sku'i rjes gnang thob pa'i phan yon la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis te/ gnas skabs su lus kyi gnad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/

mthar thug tu mtshan dpe brgyan pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku thob pa'i dgos pa yod do// zhes brjod do// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal dang gsol gdab gong ltar ro// de nas slob dpon gnyis ka 'jam dpal du bskyed pa'i snying gar/ pad zla'i steng du hrīḥyig gser gyi mdog can gyi mtha' mar/ oṃ a pa ra tsa dhīḥn maḥ zhes sngags phreng bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal nas nar gyis thon nas/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ snying khar dhīḥyig la 'khor bar dmigs nas/ phreng ba la 'jus te/ sngags kyi rjes zlos nyer gcig byed du gzhug /mthar phreng ba slob ma'i mgrin par reg ste/ slob dpon gyi ngag tu/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rigs sngags 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod de slob mas kyang de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur nas brjod du gzhug go / 'di'i phan yon la gnas skabs dang mthar thug la gnyis las/ gnas skabs su sngags kyi nus pa che zhing*/ ngag 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhas pa dang*/ (242)mthar thug ngag bden pa'i tshig 'grub cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dang gsol gdab gong ltar/ de nas slob ma lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du byas la/ mdun gyi bar snang la yi ge dhīḥdamar po gur gum gyi mdog lta bu 'od zer 'bar ba zhig bsgom/ de nas rang lus 'ja' lus su yal nas/ mdun gyi bar snang gi dhīḥyig la thim pa la rig pa gtad/ mthar dhīḥyig nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song bar bsam la/ sems stong gsal nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa ltar spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag tu bcug /'di'i phan yon la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye ba dang*/

mthar thug tu chos nyid ji lta ba bzhin rtogs nas/ chos can ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i dgos pa yod do// bzhi pa yon tan gyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gong ltar gdab/ de nas slob ma 'jam dbyangs su bskyed la/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i lag pa g.yas su ral gri gtad la/ 'di ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi phyag mtshan shes rab kyi ral gri yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi myu gu rtsa gnas chod cig / ces bya'o// 'di la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par 'gyur zhing*/ mthar thug tu sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan mtha' dag thob par 'gyur ro// (243)lnga pa phrin las rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dang gsol gdab gong ltar ro// de nas slob ma rnams 'jam dbyangs su bskyed la/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i lag pa g.yon du po ti gtad la/ 'di ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rgyud zhugs pa yin gyi/ khyed rang yang nyams su longs la gzhan la yang rgya cher ston cig / ces bya'o// 'di'i phan yon la gnyis/ gnas skabs su phrin las bzhi 'grub cing sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ mthar thug tu sangs rgyas kyi phrin las 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod do// zhes brjod do// de nas bla ma la gtang rag gi yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de nas bzung ste khyod bran du// khyed la bdag nyid 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// ces lan gsum brjod la/ phyag lan gsum 'tshal nas/ bka' drin chen zhes brjod du gzhug go /gsum pa rjes ni gtang rag gi mchod pa dang bstod par bya/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya/ bkra shis brjod/ rten zhugs na brtan bzhugs bya/ mi bzhugs na

badz+ra muṃḥ sa ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig rang la bsdu/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// tshul 'di bla ma'i zhal nas gsungs pa bzhin// ma nor ma 'chug rang bzos ma gos pa// ji ltar gsungs bzhin 'od dpag rdo rjes bkod// dge bas 'gro kun 'jam pa'i dbyangs thob shog /'di la zhal shes zur tsam zhig yod do// / khrid yig ltar bskyed do// de la ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ bsnyen pa bskyal lo// bzhi pa ni slar yang 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin no// tshogs (244)bdag 'jug skabs 'dir blangs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ dang po slob ma rjes su bzung ba/ gnyis pa bum pa dbang gi dod dang*/ gsum pa gsang ba'i dbang gi dod dang*/ bzhi pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dod dang*/ lnga pa dbang bzhi'i dod dang lnga'o// dang po slob ma rjes su bzung ba la don bzhi ste/ khrus bya zhing bgegs gtor btang la/ zhi drag gis bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom mo// mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba'i skabs su/ maṇ+ḍal dang gsol gdab gong dang mthun/ de nas dpon slob gnyis ka 'jam dbyangs su bskyed pa'i spyi bor 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ mgrin par dmar po/ snying khar sngon po/ lte bar ser po/ gsang gnas su ljang khu bskyed la/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tha mi dad pa'i gnas lnga'i 'jam dbyangs las 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga mar me las mar me chad pa'i tshul du byung nas/ slob ma'i gnas lngar thim pas/ dug lnga dag ye shes lnga mngon du gyur par bsgom/ yang dpon slob gnyis 'jam dbyangs su gsal ba'i phrag pa g.yas na rdo rje 'jigs byed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas pad+mas mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dbang gnyis dod do// rwa rnon po sngo zangs pa la rus pa'i rgyan cha 'khor ba/ mi mgo'i do shal dang*/ sbrul rgyan dang rin po ches brgyan pa/

glang po che'i pags pa gsol bar bsgom/ phrag pa g.yon par 'jigs byed dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri thod 'dzin pa/ dpyi 'go g.yas su 'jigs byed ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri thod 'dzin pa/ dpyi mgo (245)g.yon par 'jigs byed ljang gu rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i gri thod 'dzin pa/ snying khar 'jigs byed mthing kha rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri thod 'dzin pa/ de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong pa can/ rwa rnon pa'i sngo zangs zangs pa la rus pa'i rgyan drug 'khor ba/ mi mgo'i do shal dang sbrul dang rus pas brgyan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom mo// de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tha mi dad pa'i sku la 'jigs byed rigs lnga mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung nas/ slob ma'i gnas lnga'i 'jigs byed lnga la thim pas/ bde stong rdo rje lta bu'i sku mngon du gyur par bsgom pa dbang gsum pa'i dod do mo/ de nas snying kha'i 'jigs byed mthing kha thugs kha'i 'jam dbyangs mthing kha la thim par bsgom mo// de bzhin du phrag pa g.yas kyi 'jigs byed dmar po mgrin pa'i 'jam dbyangs/ dmar po la thim/ phrag pa g.yon gyi 'jigs byed dkar po spyi gtsug gi 'jam dbyangs dkar po la thim/ dpyi mgo g.yas kyi 'jigs byed ser po lte ba'i 'jam dbyangs ser po la thim/ dpyi mgo g.yon gyi 'jigs byed ljang gu gsang gnas kyi 'jam dbyangs ljang khu la thim par bsam/ de nas gsang gnas kyi 'jam dbyangs lte ba'i 'jam dbyangs la thim/ de nyid snying kha'i 'jam dbyangs la thim/ de mgrin pa'i 'jam (246)dbyangs la thim/ de spyi bo'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas/ thig le ljang ser sngo dmar dkar ba'i 'od hril le ba/ 'od zer sna lnga 'phro bar gyur bar bsgom/

de nas rang lus kyang 'od du zhu nas spyi bo'i thig le la thim/ de nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song bar bsam la/ sems gsal stong mtha' dbus med pa/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa ltar/ spros pa thams cad bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i dod do don gyi rjes gnang ngo*// gong gi zhal las shes pa'i don 'di yin/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum par bsam/ pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ dang sna tshogs rdo rje las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon zhi ma khro/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ pad zla la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa bskyed/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang lta bu'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ dbang bskur bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ las bum la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ khro bo chen po brjid pa'i (247)sku// phrag dog rnam dag bdag nyid can// gnod byed ma lus 'dul mdzad pa// bdud rtsi 'khyil ba phyag 'tshal bstod// sna tshogs rdo rje phyag g.yas kyis// nyid kyi thugs khar 'gying nas bsnams// g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten pa// rnam rol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sarba maṅga lam/// /
